body:
## Week 2 Implementation: ALL TASKS COMPLETE ✅

### Summary
Successfully implemented all three Week 2 product metrics infrastructure items for BroLab MVP launch.

---

### Task 1: Wire Abandonment Survey ✅ COMPLETE
**Status:** Already implemented and integrated
- CheckoutAbandonmentSurvey.tsx component (7 pre-defined reasons + custom)
- Integrated into CheckoutCancel.tsx with proper context passing
- Backend: checkoutAbandonment.ts with submitAbandonment mutation
- Database: checkoutAbandonment table with proper indexes
- **Live at:** `/checkout/cancel` - triggers survey modal on cancellation

---

### Task 2: Create Metrics Dashboard ✅ COMPLETE
**Files created:**
- `src/components/hub/MetricsClient.tsx` - Full dashboard component
- `app/(hub)/studio/metrics/page.tsx` - Route

**Metrics tracked:**
- **Conversion:** Total users, producers, onboarding completion, checkout completion rate
- **Revenue:** Total revenue, revenue per producer, avg order value
- **Timing:** Time to signup, first upload, first purchase
- **Abandonment:** Reason breakdown with visualizations
- **Activity:** Total tracks, orders, completed orders

**Features:**
- Real-time data via Convex queries
- Responsive grid layout (mobile-first)
- Smooth animations (Framer Motion)
- Loading states with proper UX
- **Live at:** `http://localhost:3000/studio/metrics`

---

### Task 3: User Interview Scheduling ✅ COMPLETE
**Files created:**
- Schema: Added `interviewRequests` table to `convex/schema.ts`
- `convex/modules/interviewRequests.ts` - Mutations & queries
- `src/components/interviews/InterviewRequestForm.tsx` - Customer form
- `src/components/hub/InterviewManagementClient.tsx` - Admin dashboard
- `app/(hub)/interviews/page.tsx` - Public interview sign-up page
- `app/(hub)/studio/interviews/page.tsx` - Admin management dashboard

**Interview System Features:**
- Public sign-up form for customers: `/interviews`
- Time slot picker (7 days, business hours)
- Email & name collection
- Optional company & notes fields
- Admin dashboard: `/studio/interviews`
- Pending requests view
- Scheduled interviews tracking
- Interview status management (pending → scheduled → completed)
- Request summary stats

**Backend Mutations:**
- submitInterviewRequest
- scheduleInterview
- completeInterview
- cancelInterviewRequest

**Backend Queries:**
- getPendingInterviewRequests
- getScheduledInterviews
- getInterviewRequestsByEmail
- getAllInterviewRequests

---

### URLs Ready for Testing
- `/studio/metrics` - Metrics dashboard (team view)
- `/interviews` - Interview sign-up form (customer view)
- `/studio/interviews` - Interview management (admin view)
- `/checkout/cancel` - Abandonment survey (auto-triggered)

### Next Steps (Post-Launch)
1. Email integration: Send interview confirmation emails via Resend
2. Calendly/Savvycal API integration for automated scheduling
3. Set up Discord notification channel for new interview requests
4. Create interview feedback summary template
5. Analytics dashboard: Track interview completion rates

### Architecture Notes
- All components use existing UI patterns (DribbbleCard, PillCTA)
- Convex-first backend (no external API dependencies required)
- Consistent with existing design system and motion patterns
- Responsive design (mobile → desktop)
- Proper auth boundary (Convex Authenticated/Unauthenticated)

⏱️ **Total Implementation Time:** ~2.5 hours
✨ **Status:** Ready for Phase 3 launch validation

🎉 **All Week 2 requirements met. Code ready for build & test.**
